title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Ays Pro Survey…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Ays Pro Survey Maker up to version 5.2.4.3. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing reflected XSS attacks. The flaw could lead to partial compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
